title: Configure Resend Email Provider for Magic Links
description: Set up Resend as the email provider so magic links are actually sent via email instead of just logged to Convex dashboard. RESEND_API_KEY is already in .env.local.

currentFiles: convex/betterAuth.ts - Better Auth config, needs Resend integration

acceptanceCriteria.text: Use Context7 MCP to look up Better Auth magic link + email provider setup
Install resend package: bun add resend
Configure Better Auth sendMagicLink to use Resend API
Set from email to something like noreply@heyman.net or similar verified domain
Update convex/betterAuth.ts with Resend email sending
Start dev server: bun run dev
Check actual email inbox - magic link email should arrive
Click magic link in email - should log in successfully

blockedBy: Code implementation complete. RESEND_API_KEY must be added to Convex environment variables at dashboard.convex.dev > Settings > Environment Variables. User needs to: 1) Go to dashboard.convex.dev 2) Navigate to Settings > Environment Variables 3) Add RESEND_API_KEY with value from .env.local. After that, email delivery can be verified.
